svg.title: Regime shifts in aquatic ecosystems and an algal-carbon-nutrient simulation model
svg.desc: Conceptual lake and river regime-shift diagrams above a detailed algal, carbon, nutrient, and dissolved oxygen simulation model.

text.tspan: Diagram of the algal–carbon–nutrient simulation models adapted from Zhang and Johnson.
Aquatic Nutrient Simulation Modules (NSMs) Developed for Hydrologic and Hydraulic Models. 2016. ERDC/EL TR-16-1.
